subject: Vendor onboarding: Coupa/Ariba setup + PO mapping / Redwood MSA & Order Form
messages:
From: Anjali Singh <anjali.singh@bluepeak.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.io
Cc: procurement@bluepeak.com, tom.reynolds@bluepeak.com
Date: 2026-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood — next steps

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our procurement team is ready to onboard Redwood as a supplier in our systems. We primarily use Coupa but can accept Ariba if Redwood prefers. To scope the work and get POs flowing, could you share the required vendor details and confirm the following: 

- Does Redwood accept POs (preferred) or invoices only? If POs, do you require a specific PO field mapping for Order Form items (product code, model, model_version, unit_price, subscription_term)?
- Legal: we need a countersigned MSA and an Order Form that maps to our procurement fields. Can you confirm whether Redwood uses the standard MSA + separate Order Form flow?
- Please provide remit address, tax ID (or W-9), insurance cert, and preferred invoice email.

We have attached our vendor_info_request_form.pdf — please return that and let us know whether you want a supplier invite in Coupa or an Ariba registration link. Our target is getting Redwood into Coupa and receiving a PO by 5/12.

Thanks,
Anjali Singh
Sr. Procurement Manager | BluePeak Logistics
anjali.singh@bluepeak.com
Attachment: vendor_info_request_form.pdf (form, 1 page)
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.io
To: Anjali Singh <anjali.singh@bluepeak.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.io, rishi_malhotra@redwood.io, marissa_cole@redwood.io
Date: 2026-05-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood — next steps

Hi Anjali — great to hear and thanks for the form. I added Laura (AM) and Rishi (Legal) to help close the loop. Quick answers and an action checklist below.

Short answers:
- We support PO-driven purchases (preferred) and invoice processing; PO is the recommended flow for subscription/order tracking.
- Redwood uses a Master Services Agreement (MSA) paired with an Order Form that lists SKUs/pricing and term. We can map Order Form fields to Coupa/Ariba fields — I've attached a one-page registration checklist and can share a mapping file.

Action checklist (what we will deliver):
- Return completed vendor_info_request_form (will attach completed W-9 + remit) — Diego
- Provide MSA redlines and an editable Order Form mapping table — Rishi
- Create Coupa supplier profile or accept Ariba invite — Laura to coordinate supplier invite

Could you do these on your side:
- Send a Coupa supplier invite to vendor@redwood.com OR forward the Ariba supplier registration link to me
- Confirm required PO fields (any custom fields beyond standard PO# / net30 / GL code)

Attachments: redwood_vendor_registration_checklist.docx (checklist, 1 page)

Next steps: Laura will reach out to schedule a short procurement sync (15–20 min) to confirm PO mapping. Rishi will upload marked redlines for the MSA by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vendor@redwood.com
From: laura_bennett@redwood.io
To: Anjali Singh <anjali.singh@bluepeak.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.io
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.io
Date: 2026-05-02T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood — next steps

Anjali / Diego — looping in as promised. Happy to own the Coupa/Ariba supplier setup and work directly with BluePeak procurement. Proposed mutual action plan:

- Today (5/2): BluePeak sends Coupa invite or Ariba link to vendor@redwood.com — Anjali
- 5/3: Redwood returns completed vendor form + W-9 + insurance cert — Diego
- 5/3–5/4: Legal review and upload of MSA redlines; provide Order Form mapping spreadsheet — Rishi
- 5/5: Quick procurement sync (15m) to confirm PO fields and any GL/accounting codes — Laura + BluePeak procurement
- Goal: First PO issued by 5/12

Couple of notes: if BluePeak requires punchout integration for catalog items, we can do a limited catalog export, but for now the Order Form mapping will suffice for subscription-based items.

Can you confirm a preferred time for the 5/5 sync? Late morning PST works for us.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.io
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.io
To: Anjali Singh <anjali.singh@bluepeak.com>, diego_fernandez@redwood.io
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.io
Date: 2026-05-03T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood — MSA redlines and mapping

Hi Anjali / team — attaching our redlines to the MSA and a draft Order Form mapping (OrderForm_mapping_BP.xlsx). Summary of the key commercial/legal items from our side:

- Liability cap: standard SAAS cap (subscription fees x12) — we maintained language but can discuss carve-outs for data breach scope.
- Data processing: Redwood will provide SOC2 evidence; data access limited to runtime/ops; no resale.
- Audit logs: we can provide access-level logs subject to an NDA and reasonable scope.
- Payment terms: Net30 standard; E-invoicing preferred (send to invoices@redwood.com).
- PO acceptance: We will accept a BluePeak PO that references the countersigned Order Form; please ensure PO contains field mapping for sku, model_version, unit_price, term_start, term_end.

Request: Can we get a short call between BluePeak legal and our counsel to walk the redlines? 20 minutes should be enough to resolve the routine items.

Attachments: MSA_redlines_BluePeak_v3.pdf (redlined MSA), OrderForm_mapping_BP.xlsx (mapping table)

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.io
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.io
To: Anjali Singh <anjali.singh@bluepeak.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@bluepeak.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.io, rishi_malhotra@redwood.io, marissa_cole@redwood.io
Date: 2026-05-04T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood — Coupa setup complete + DocuSign link for Order Form

Anjali / Tom — quick update and confirmation:

- Coupa registration: Completed. BluePeak assigned vendor ID BP-98724 and invited vendor@redwood.com. Thank you for the invite.
- Documents uploaded: W-9, remit address, insurance cert uploaded to the supplier profile.
- PO mapping: we confirmed the following essential PO fields: PO#, sku, model_version, unit_price, term_start, term_end, billing_contact, GL_code (optional). Our Order Form mapping spreadsheet has been shared to the Coupa attachment area.
- MSA redlines: Rishi shared redlines and is available for a short call — please propose a time tomorrow 5/5 between 10:00–13:00 PST and we'll confirm.
- DocuSign: Uploaded a draft Order Form and sent a DocuSign powerform link for execution: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&token=abcd1234

Next steps for us:
- Rishi to finalize minor redline replies after the legal call.
- Laura to track PO issuance and confirm first PO details.
- Marissa will monitor Coupa ticket and confirm invoicing route (invoices@redwood.com).

If that aligns, we should be in position to receive the first PO by 5/12 as discussed. Thanks for the speedy coordination — appreciate the procurement team's help.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vendor@redwood.com
